title: Bass is dead everywhere

complaints.says: The bass has disappeared from the mains and every wedge. The bass player says his amp sounds fine.

hints: The amp still works, so the bass and its cable are fine. What sits between the bass and the stagebox?
cause: The bass DI is an active DI and its battery died. The amp kept working because the DI's thru jack is passive.
lesson: Active DIs need a battery or 48V phantom power. Turning on 48V for the DI's input is the quick fix mid-service; swap the battery afterwards.
